g.text: Agent Teams Workflow v2 — capability grant versus invocation
GRANT is a signature over the publication tuple:
only the registry key may replace the entry.
INVOKE is possession of the URI: lookup is
unauthenticated, so the designator is public
while send-authority lives in the bundled name.
Publishing hands the entry capability and the
manifest read to everyone. It confers no
authority over the publisher's own runs.
knowledge of the URI = authority to send
beginRun records the INVOKER as owner
